implementation_summary: Wrote engineering/architecture.md from code. It covers the component map, a Mermaid diagram with no layer violations, API contracts, a files-only data model keyed by host, cross-cutting concerns, scalability, where each REQ group lands and which ADRs apply, three Q-01 positioning options with evidence, 14 risks and 14 recommendations (REC-02 to REC-12 marked P2), documentation-versus-code contradictions, and a not-assessed list. Main finding: ADR 0031's outbound-request rules are marked accepted but are not in code. Orchestrator note: safeGet is also used at runner/src/server.ts:1462 and core/src/safe-net.ts:213 (Verified Domain proof), not only docs-fetch.ts.

findings.title: ADR 0031 (Accepted) outbound-request rules are not implemented: page-derived requests bypass safeGet
findings.recommendation: Implement T-43 as ADR 0031 states: route sitemap and robots Sitemap: fetches, the SEO broken-link check (seo.ts:555, GET only) and checker fetches (security-depth.ts:146, no Playwright request-API fallback) through safeGet, and add the outbound source-grep test. Do this before any third-party audit feature ships on the hosted copy.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md wizard import rule differs from code and guard test
findings.recommendation: Update CLAUDE.md to match the browser.ts guard (only @qa/types/src/browser.js by path), or move the wizard's value imports to browser.js.

findings.title: safe-public scan path is API-only and runs a narrower checker set than the Check-up
findings.recommendation: If option 2 (separate entry point) is chosen, build on this path but align which checkers it runs with the orchestrator; otherwise record it as legacy.

questions: Q-01 positioning: Check-up mode, separate entry point on the shared engine, or separate product (options and trade-offs in architecture.md).
Should the ADR 0031 implementation gap be opened as a blocking task now, separate from these requirements?
risks: R-01 ADR 0031 not in code: unguarded outbound requests on the hosted copy (High/High)
R-02 Hosted persistence: /tmp on one instance cannot hold saved Apps or shortlist (High/High)
R-03 Helper accounts need an identity and tenancy layer that does not exist (Medium/High)
R-04 Plaintext key fallback file conflicts with REQ-040 (Medium/High)
R-05 Third-party load: run phase unpaced, Crawl-delay ignored, ADR 0015 deferred (Medium/Medium)
R-06 External API quotas and keys (Medium/Medium)
R-07 Tamil fonts and lang in HTML/PDF/Word (High/Medium)
R-08 AI cost per page for six-area assessment (High/Medium)
R-09 Glossary collisions: Plan, project, sitemap, App, Requirement (High/Medium)
R-10 Claim wording and verdict misuse in pitch documents (Medium/High)
R-11 Personal data (NAP, notes) with no retention rule (Medium/High)
R-12 Report size and memory from per-page content (Medium/Medium)
R-14 New routes added to the server.ts if-chain instead of the route table (Low/Medium)
handoff: Orchestrator: copy R-01 to R-14 into engineering/risks.md. Raise Q-01 as the gating decision; REC-02 to REC-12 need developer approval. REC-01 (ADR 0031 code) is a prerequisite for any third-party audit work. Not assessed: wizard screen internals, html-report body, redact.ts, planner internals, ADRs 0004/0006/0013/0014/0016/0019/0020/0022-0026, DEPLOYMENT/CONFIGURATION docs, Playwright base-image fonts, external API quotas.
